meta.groups_keys: '<band> | <layer>', '<band>3 | <layer>' (three-band grouping), '<band> | all layers', '<band>3 | all layers', 'all bands | <layer>', 'all bands | all layers'

weights.transport: W_kx = w_k a_kx/a_k, w_k = positive part of the record-mean level transport normalised over the section; sums to 1

meta.circulation_frozen: record-mean V_bc of the named reanalysis, interpolated to the product levels; renormalised over the levels with ocean
meta.trend_units: PSU per decade (salinity); transport-weight fraction is dimensionless
meta.intervals: 95 per cent; trend intervals from trend_test (bias-corrected lag-one effective sample size); share intervals from the joint AR(1) sieve bootstrap

limitations.core_argo_only: not computed: no profile-level EN4 files in data/en4 (gridded monthly g10 fields only)
